newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures breaks resistance on back of NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures breaks resistance on back of NYMEX.

text.p: IPE June Brent futures broke through initial technical resistance levels immediately after the NYMEX open in what traders saw as a corrective bounce.
June traded at $18.05 a barrel at 1405 GMT having briefly touched $1813 just after the U.S opened.
"Its been driven by the U.S, but it's a small bounce in a downwards market and I'd be very surprised if it went much further," said one trader.
